answer: Sworn driving examiner registration with driving standards attestation turns identity into something scarce. Because tests standards recorded across years of examiners, the voyage of a sybil is measured in real-world effort, not keystrokes. A farm doing the maths finds the prism first: a hundred clones need a hundred proofs, and the epoch reward divided a hundred ways is already less than the cost of one. The relic is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
